goal: 修复默认 skill 安装未包含 Pi 的行为断层

summary.title: Include Pi in default Mainline skill installation
summary.what: Fixed the default Mainline skill install path so Pi receives the same global Mainline skill as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. `defaultSkillInstallCommand` now passes `--agent codex claude-code cursor pi`. Tests now assert the Pi agent is part of the default command and that an existing `~/.pi/agent/skills/mainline/SKILL.md` is recognized as an already-installed global skill. README and `skills/mainline/SKILL.md` command examples were updated to include Pi. This intent also includes the earlier Pi hook integration, Pi extension template extraction, and local-dev hook fail-soft fixes present on the branch.
summary.why: The PR already documented and installed Pi hooks as a supported default agent, and existing skill detection already knew about Pi's `~/.pi/agent/skills/mainline/SKILL.md` path, but the default `skills add` command omitted `pi`. That meant `mainline init` could install Pi hooks while failing to install Pi's Mainline workflow skill, contradicting the docs and creating an inconsistent Pi onboarding path.
summary.user_goal: 修复默认 skill 安装未包含 Pi 的行为断层

decisions.chose: Add `pi` to the explicit `--agent` list rather than using `--agent *`.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the existing intentional scope of installing only Mainline's supported/default agents while making Pi consistent with the newly added hook/docs support.

decisions.chose: Update the exact command expectation and add coverage for Pi's global skill install location.
decisions.rationale: The old test had frozen the bug by expecting only codex/claude-code/cursor; the new coverage prevents regressing Pi skill installation or Pi skill skip detection.

rejected.alternative: Switch the default install command to `--agent *`.
rejected.reason: That would install Mainline's skill for many agents outside this PR's supported hook/default integration scope.

review_notes: Validated `skills add ... --agent pi` in an isolated temporary HOME; it exits 0 and writes `~/.pi/agent/skills/mainline/SKILL.md`.
Full test suite passed locally; `internal/engine` took about 362 seconds.

architectural_claims: Pi is now consistently treated as a default supported Mainline agent across hooks, docs, skill detection, and default skill installation.
Pi extension source is kept as a TypeScript template rather than an opaque Go raw string.
Local-dev hook wrappers should fail soft at the host boundary and report Go version repair reasons through hooks status.
behavioral_changes: `mainline init` default skill installation now includes `--agent pi`, so Pi gets the Mainline skill under `~/.pi/agent/skills/mainline/SKILL.md` when the default skill install path runs.
Existing Pi global skill installs are detected and cause default skill install to skip like other global skill paths.
Manual README/skill install commands now include Pi.
security_implications: No new privilege model; the change extends the already-default global Mainline skill installation to Pi's documented global skill directory.
migration_notes: Users who already ran init with a Pi-capable but pre-fix binary can run `npx --yes skills add mainline-org/mainline --skill mainline --agent pi --global --yes` or rerun the default skill install flow to populate Pi's global skill.
